name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Paid Media Specialist | Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, CPA/CPC Optimization & ROI Reporting
summary: Paid media and performance marketer with 15+ years across agency, SaaS, and marketing operations, running campaigns and explaining the results in plain language. Optimizes Google Ads accounts for lead quality and click-through, runs A/B-tested LinkedIn campaigns, and holds a Meta Ads certification. Advised agency clients on paid-campaign budget planning and allocation, and built reporting on ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion. Sets up GA4 and Google Tag Manager on every site so paid traffic is tracked correctly, and connects the dots between ads, SEO, websites, and social for business owners. Worked with established retail brands at Wix, and fluent in Salesforce, Jira, Excel, and Google Sheets.

Build dashboards tracking lead volume, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline, and report results with recommendations on a regular cadence.
Run local SEO and Google Business Profile programs for service businesses, and explain SEO, website, and social tradeoffs to owners in plain language.
Manage multiple client campaigns at once, keeping work on schedule and within scope.
